change: Known Issues, extended: Ground Team can now mark a job 'Can't Complete' directly on the checklist mid-repair (no parts / no manpower / needs replacement), naming the part needed — collapses to one line, creates a truck-level Known Issue. Reminder banner now also shows on Ground Team (not just Supervisor) every time that truck is worked on, so it can be cross-checked before loading. New Stores tab: 'Field-Reported Parts Needed' with its own download, for ordering ahead of the next breakdown.
